item.title: Kim Min-seok Posts Trump Panmunjom Photo, Announces "Plan to Visit US, China, and Japan Within the Year" (김민석, 트럼프 판문점 사진 올리며 “연내 미중일 방문 추진”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Posts Trump Panmunjom Photo, Announces "Plan to Visit US, China, and Japan Within the Year" (김민석, 트럼프 판문점 사진 올리며 “연내 미중일 방문 추진”)

Kim Min-seok, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 16th, "If I become party leader, I will push for visits to the US, China, and Japan within the year." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표 후보가 16일 “당대표가 되면 연내 미중일 방문을 추진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

On the same day, the candidate posted on his X account a photo of U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un taken at Panmunjom. The photo had been uploaded the previous day by President Trump on his social media platform Truth Social, accompanied by the remark, "Kim Jong-un and I get along very well." <<> In his post accompanying the photo, Kim stated, "Actually, when I met President Trump at the White House, after he heard my approach to North Korea, he spontaneously had that photo brought out, showed it to me, and we had a conversation." (김 후보는 이날 자신의 X에 판문점에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 찍은 사진을 게시했다. 전날 트럼프 대통령이 자시의 소셜미디어 트루스소셜에 “김정은과 나는 아주 잘 지낸다”며 올린 사진이었다.)

He added, "At the time, President Trump showed great interest in my private proposal and immediately issued related instructions." (김 후보는 사진과 함께 올린 글에서 “실은 제가 백악관에서 트럼프 대통령을 만났을 때 제 북한 해법을 들은 트럼프 대통령이 즉석에서 저 사진을 가져오라고 해서 제게 보여주며 대화를 나눴다”고 했다.)

Kim said, "If I become party leader, I will push for visits to the US, China, and Japan within the year, and also pursue 'bipartisan party diplomacy'—meeting bipartisan counterparts with bipartisan members—something I could not accomplish during my time as prime minister." (그러면서 “트럼프 대통령은 당시 저의 비공개 제안에 큰 흥미를 보이고 바로 관련 지시를 내렸다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party-Lawmakers on Judiciary Committee Accuse Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae of Dereliction of Duty, Mention Impeachment and Crime of Distorting Law: "Delaying Trials for Kim Keon-hee" (與 법사위, 조희대 향해 탄핵·법왜곡죄 거론 “김건희 재판 지연 직무 유기”)
item.description:
Ruling Party-Lawmakers on Judiciary Committee Accuse Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae of Dereliction of Duty, Mention Impeachment and Crime of Distorting Law: "Delaying Trials for Kim Keon-hee" (與 법사위, 조희대 향해 탄핵·법왜곡죄 거론 “김건희 재판 지연 직무 유기”)

Ruling bloc lawmakers on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee said on the 16th, targeting Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, "We will surely hold accountable the Chief Justice's dereliction of duty in delaying trials for insurrection and state power abuse offenders, including Kim Keon-hee." (국회 법제사법위원회 소속 범여권 의원들은 조희대 대법원장을 겨냥해 “김건희 등 내란 및 국정농단 사범 재판지연하는 대법원장의 직무유기, 반드시 책임을 묻겠다”라고 16일 밝혔다.)

On the same day, lawmakers on the Judiciary Committee from the Democratic Party of Korea, the ReBuilding Korea Party, and the Progressive Party issued a statement saying, "The appellate court sentenced Han Duck-soo and Lee Sang-min to heavy sentences of 15 years and 9 years in prison, respectively, and Kim Keon-hee was also sentenced to 4 years in prison in the second trial. However, the final legal judgments on their criminal charges, already proven in lower courts, have been postponed." (이날 더불어민주당, 조국혁신당, 진보당 법사위 의원들은 입장문을 내고 “한덕수와 이상민에게 항소심 재판부는 각각 징역 15년과 징역 9년의 중형을 선고했고, 김건희 피고인의 혐의에 대해서도 2심에서 징역 4년의 실형이 선고됐다”면서 “그러나 이미 하급심을 통해 입증된 이들의 범죄 혐의에 대한 최종적인 법적 판단은 미뤄지게 됐다”고 했다.)

They added, "The responsibility lies with the Supreme Court under Cho Hee-dae, which decided to refer the cases to the en banc panel just days before the statutory deadline for the final appeal rulings." (그러면서 “상고심 선고 법정 시한을 며칠 앞두고 전원합의체 회부를 결정한 조희대 대법원에 그 책임이 있다”고 했다.)

Holding Chief Justice Cho accountable, they said, "This decision, which clearly exceeds the deadline for handling final appeals, can hardly avoid public criticism that the highest court has effectively endorsed and provided justification for the 'delay tactics and trial-stalling strategy' the defendants have persistently demanded." (조 대법원장에게 책임을 물으며 “상고심 처리 기한을 명백히 넘기게 된 이번 결정은 피고인들이 줄기차게 요구해 온 ‘시간 끌기·재판 지연 전략’에 최고법원이 사실상 동조하고 명분을 깔아줬다는 국민적 비판을 면하기 어렵다”고 했다.)

They also said, "Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, appointed by Yoon Suk Yeol, has consistently emphasized the '633 principle' under the rule of law and called for swift trials since taking office. So why is he now breaking the '3-month principle' he himself so strongly stressed?" (또 “윤석열이 임명한 조희대 대법원장 자신도 취임 이후 줄곧 법대로 ‘633 원칙’을 강조하며 신속한 재판을 주문해 왔다” “그런데 왜 지금은 자신이 그토록 강조했던 ‘3개월 원칙’을 깨버리는 것이냐”라고도 했다.)

They demanded three things from Chief Justice Cho: "Clearly present specific dates for the en banc hearings and final rulings for insurrection and state power abuse offenders," "Clearly promise to deliver final appeal rulings before the release deadlines for Han Duck-soo, Lee Sang-min, and Kim Keon-hee," and "Immediately recommend Supreme Court justices." (이들은 조 대법원장에게 3가지를 요구했다. “내란 및 국정농단 사범들의 구체적인 전원합의체 기일과 최종 선고 시점을 명확히 제시하라” “한덕수, 이상민, 김건희의 석방 기한 전 상고심 선고를 명확히 약속하라” “대법관 제청 당장 하라”는 것이었다.)

Finally, they stated, "Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae's accountability will result in the first-ever impeachment of a Supreme Court Chief Justice in the history of the Republic of Korea and punishment for the crime of distorting the law." (마지막으로 이들은 “조희대 대법원장의 책임은 대한민국 역사상 최초의 대법원장 탄핵과 법왜곡죄 처벌이 될 것”이라고도 했다.)

item.title: Pro-Chung 5th-place Han Min-soo and Pro-Myung 6th-place Kim Yong Differ by 0.15%p in Party Supreme Council Race (與 최고위원 5위 친청 한민수·6위 친명 김용 0.15%p차)
item.description:
Pro-Chung 5th-place Han Min-soo and Pro-Myung 6th-place Kim Yong Differ by 0.15%p in Party Supreme Council Race (與 최고위원 5위 친청 한민수·6위 친명 김용 0.15%p차)

The race for the Democratic Party of Korea's Supreme Council member seats in the Aug. 17 national convention is seeing major shifts in the rankings among those likely to be elected, following the regional primaries held in the Honam and Seoul metropolitan areas on the 15th and 16th. Pro-Myung (pro-Lee Jae-myung) candidates surged in Honam, pushing Cho Min-hee, the pro-Chung (pro-Jung Cheong-rae) candidate who had held the cumulative first place, down to second, while Park Sun-won briefly took the lead for the first time. However, in the Seoul metropolitan area, pro-Chung candidates gained vote shares and made a comeback. The gap between the 5th- and 6th-place candidates within the likely elected range is just 0.15 percentage points, intensifying competition in the final stretch. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 최고위원 경선이 15~16일 호남·수도권 순회경선을 거치면서 당선권 순위가 크게 요동치고 있다. 친명(친이재명)계 후보들이 호남에서 약진하면서 기존 누적 1위였던 친청(친정청래)계 최민희 후보가 2위로 내려앉고 박선원 후보가 처음으로 선두에 올라섰다가, 수도권에서는 친청계가 득표율을 올리면서 약진했다. 당선권인 5위와 6위 후보간 격차가 0.15%포인트에 불과해 막판 경쟁이 한층 치열해졌다.)

After the party completed regional primaries in all areas as of today, among the eight Supreme Council candidates, Cho Min-hee leads with 16.91% (259,744 votes). (민주당이 이날까지 전 권역에서 순회경선을 마친 결과 경선 결과 8명의 최고위원 후보 중 1위는 최민희 후보로 16.91%(25만9744표)로 선두를 달리고 있다.)

Following her, Park Sun-won has 16.60% (255,008 votes), Seo Mi-hwa 15.18% (233,245 votes), Lee Seong-yoon 13.94% (214,118 votes), Han Min-soo 13.77% (211,479 votes), Kim Yong 13.62% (209,167 votes), Im Mi-ae 6.62% (101,614 votes), and Kim Young-ho 3.37% (51,731 votes). (이어 박선원 후보는 16.60%(25만5008표), 서미화 후보는 15.18%(23만3245표), 이성윤 후보는 13.94%(21만4118표), 한민수 후보는 13.77%(21만1479표), 김용 후보는 13.62%(20만9167표), 임미애 후보는 6.62%(10만1614표), 김영호 후보는 3.37%(5만1731표) 등 순이었다.)

After the Seoul and Gyeonggi regional primaries held today, the first-place position switched back from pro-Myung candidate Park Sun-won to pro-Chung candidate Cho Min-hee. Park Sun-won had taken first place the previous day in the Honam regional primary, overtaking Cho Min-hee. (이날 진행된 서울·경기 지역 순회경선 이후 1위가 친명계 박선원 후보에서 친청계 최민희 후보로 다시 바뀌었다. 박선원 후보는 전날 호남 순회경선에선 최민희 후보를 누르고 1위를 차지했었다.)

Kim Yong had moved into the elected range the previous day by surpassing Lee Seong-yoon in the Honam primary, but fell to sixth place after the Seoul metropolitan area vote. Among the five candidates within the elected range, Park Sun-won and Seo Mi-hwa are classified as pro-Myung, while Cho Min-hee, Lee Seong-yoon, and Han Min-soo are considered pro-Chung. (김용 후보는 전날 호남 경선에서 이성윤 후보를 앞지르고 당선권에 들었으나 수도권 투표 이후 6위로 밀려났다. 당선권에 든 5명 후보 중 박선원·서미화 후보는 친명계로 분류되고, 최민희·이성윤·한민수 후보는 친청계로 꼽힌다.)

The cumulative vote share gap from 4th to 6th place is only 0.3 percentage points, and the difference between 5th-place pro-Chung Han Min-soo and 6th-place pro-Myung Kim Yong is just 0.15 percentage points (about 2,000 votes). Accordingly, the public opinion poll and delegate vote results announced on the day of the convention on the 17th will be the final variable. Kim issued a press release that day appealing to national delegates, saying, "Please use that one vote to protect Lee Jae-myung." (4위부터 6위까지의 누적 득표율 차이가 불과 0.3%포인트로 크지 않고 5위 친청 한민수 후보와 6위 친명 김용 후보의 표차도 0.15%포인트(2000여 표) 차에 불과한 상황이다. 이에 따라 17일 전당대회 당일 발표되는 국민 여론조사와 대의원 투표 결과가 마지막 변수다. 김 후보는 이날 보도자료를 내고 전국대의원들에게 “이재명을 지키는 데 그 한 표를 써주십시오”​라며 지지 호소를 했다.)

item.title: Pro-Lee Myung-hee and Kim Young-ho Withdraw from Outside Winning Range: "Make Kim Yong a Supreme Council Member" (당선권 밖 ‘친명’ 임미애·김영호 사퇴 “김용 최고위원 만들어 달라”)
item.description:
Pro-Lee Myung-hee and Kim Young-ho Withdraw from Outside Winning Range: "Make Kim Yong a Supreme Council Member" (당선권 밖 ‘친명’ 임미애·김영호 사퇴 “김용 최고위원 만들어 달라”)

On the 16th, one day before the August 17 party convention, Democratic Party of Korea Supreme Council member candidates Kim Young-ho and Rep. Im Mi-ae withdrew from their candidacies. The two lawmakers said, "Please make candidate Kim Yong a Supreme Council member." (8.17 전당대회를 하루 앞둔 16일 더불어민주당 최고위원 후보인 김영호, 임미애 의원이 후보직에서 사퇴했다. 두 의원은 “김용 후보를 최고위원으로 만들어 달라”고 전했다.)

Candidate Kim Yong, who had been within the winning range for Supreme Council member until just before that day, fell to 6th place outside the winning range in the cumulative tallies through the Seoul and Gyeonggi regional primaries. Candidate Choi Min-hee took 1st place with 16.91% (259,744 votes), followed by candidate Park Sun-won with 16.60% (255,008 votes), candidate Seo Mi-hwa with 15.18% (233,245 votes), candidate Lee Seong-yoon with 13.94% (214,118 votes), and candidate Han Min-soo with 13.77% (211,479 votes), all within the winning range. <<> As of that day, candidates outside the winning range were Kim Yong with 13.62% (209,167 votes), Im Mi-ae with 6.62% (101,614 votes), and Kim Young-ho with 3.37% (51,731 votes), in that order. <<> In response, pro-Lee Jae-myung candidates rallied in unison to support Kim Yong. Candidate Im Mi-ae announced her resignation, saying, "Please make Kim Yong a Supreme Council member," adding, "The composition of the Supreme Council is crucial. It must become a leadership that firmly supports the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." <<> Rep. Kim Young-ho said, "From this moment, I resign from the Supreme Council member candidacy and support candidate Kim Yong. I earnestly beg of the delegates. Please gather the precious vote you intended to give me, Kim Young-ho, for candidate Kim Yong, ballot number 2." <<> Party leader candidate Song Young-gil also appealed for support, saying, "Candidate Kim Yong was within the winning range through the Honam region, but was pushed out in the metropolitan area vote counting. He is a comrade who endured hardship alongside President Lee Jae-myung for many years, so I can't treat this as someone else's problem." <<> Candidate Kim Yong himself also said, "I stand outside the winning range by a razor-thin margin. Please help me just once," and "Tomorrow, for just one day, one of your two votes as delegates will decide Kim Yong's fate. Please use that one vote to protect Lee Jae-myung." <<> Meanwhile, the final results for the party leader and Supreme Council members of the Democratic Party will be announced on the 17th, combining 70% from delegate and party member voting with 30% from a public opinion poll. The public opinion poll was conducted over two days starting the 14th, targeting Democratic Party supporters and independents, and online voting among delegates will take place on the 17th. (이날 직전까지 최고위원 당선권이었던 김용 후보는 서울·경기 지역 순회경선까지 누적 집계 결과 당선권 밖인 6위로 밀려났다. 1위는 최민희 후보가 16.91%(25만9744표)를 차지했고, 박선원 후보는 16.60%(25만5008표), 서미화 후보는 15.18%(23만3245표), 이성윤 후보는 13.94%(21만4118표), 한민수 후보는 13.77%(21만1479표)로 당선권에 올랐다.)

item.title: Party member vote: Kim Min-seok 49.90%, Chung Cheong-rae 41.52% (與 당원 투표 김민석 49.90%, 정청래 41.52%)
item.description:
Party member vote: Kim Min-seok 49.90%, Chung Cheong-rae 41.52% (與 당원 투표 김민석 49.90%, 정청래 41.52%)

In the Seoul and Gyeonggi primaries for the August 17 National Convention to elect the next leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, party leader candidate Kim Min-seok received 46.66% of the vote, while candidate Chung Cheong-rae received 46.28%. Candidate Song Young-gil garnered 7.05%. (더불어민주당 차기 지도부를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회 서울·경기 경선에서 김민석 당대표 후보가 46.66%, 정청래 후보가 46.28%를 득표했다. 송영길 후보는 7.05%를 얻었다.)

As a result, the final tally of the party member vote stood at 49.90% for candidate Kim, 41.52% for candidate Chung, and 8.58% for candidate Song. (이로써 권리당원 투표 최종 결과는 김 후보 49.90%, 정 후보 41.52%, 송 후보 8.58%로 집계됐다.)

The Democratic Party elects its party leader and Supreme Council members through a formula of 70% party member voting and 30% general public opinion polling. The poll results will be combined at the National Convention to be held in Daejeon on the 17th. (민주당은 권리당원 투표 70%, 일반 국민 여론조사 30%로 당대표와 최고위원을 선출한다. 여론조사 결과는 17일 대전에서 열리는 전당대회에서 합산된다.)

Given that candidate Kim secured nearly a majority in the party member vote, the likelihood of clinching the election without a runoff has increased. A runoff remains possible if candidate Chung achieves a near-landslide result in the general public opinion poll. However, since pro-Myung faction candidate Song has built a anti-Chung alliance alongside Kim, there are observations that even if a runoff occurs, Kim's final victory is highly likely. (김 후보가 권리당원 투표에서 과반에 가까운 득표를 얻은 만큼 결선 없이 당선을 확정 지을 가능성이 커졌다. 정 후보가 일반 국민 여론조사에서 압승에 가까운 결과를 얻어낼 경우 결선 가능성이 열려 있다. 그러나 친명계 후보인 송 후보가 김 후보와 함께 반청(반정청래) 연대를 구축한 상태여서 결선이 치러져도 김 후보의 최종 승리 가능성이 높을 것이란 관측이 나온다.)

However, if none of the three candidates secures a majority, a runoff will be held using the preference voting system. The next party leader will be determined by which candidate those who ranked the third-place candidate as their first choice selected most frequently as their second choice. (다만 세 명의 후보 중 과반 득표자가 나오지 않을 경우 선호투표제 방식의 결선이 진행된다. 3위 후보자를 1순위로 뽑은 이들이 2순위로 누구를 더 많이 선택했느냐에 따라 차기 당 대표가 최종 확정된다.)

In the party member vote for the Supreme Council election, where 5 out of 8 candidates are selected, the results were in the following order: Choi Min-hee (16.92%), Park Sun-won (16.60%), Seo Mi-hwa (15.18%), Lee Seong-yun (13.93%), Han Min-su (13.77%), Kim Yong (13.61%), Im Mi-ae (6.62%), and Kim Young-ho (3.37%).
